case_seed_policy: Every native arm and seed/case layer is retained in each row. MEAN5 is an original saved aggregation, not a case or a new mean. native_axis_raw_json preserves exact numeric/string JSON tokens; native_axes provides lexical navigation coordinates.
references: GATE: no four-corner reference. O_SRC: full references. PATH: restricted and renormalized original references; retain native policy tokens.
aggregation: Native seed, endpoint, operation and container layers only; ALL3_EQUAL is a saved summary, not a fourth direction.
numeric_objects: Prediction loss/g/bar_qI use saved F32 scores promoted to F64. Response Skill concerns named CPU-F64 functions, including whole q.
state_policy: FIELD_ABSENT is not null; raw_json=null with a missing state means no token; raw_json="null" is explicit saved null. Original unresolved, conditional-empty and qualification tags retain their meanings. No scientific PASS added.
